an7.54:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an7.54:1.2: ‘Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo, yena sutavato ariyasāvakassa vicikicchā n' uppajjati avyākatavatthūsū' ti? 2.
an7.54:2.1: ‘Diṭṭhinirodhā kho bhikkhu sutavato ariyasāvakassa vicikicchā n' uppajjati avyākatavatthūsu.
an7.54:2.2: "Hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti kho bhikkhu diṭṭhigatam etaṃ;
an7.54:2.3: "na hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti kho bhikkhu diṭṭhigatam etaṃ;
an7.54:2.4: "hoti ca na ca hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti kho bhikkhu diṭṭhigatam etaṃ;
an7.54:2.5: "neva hoti na na hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti kho bhikkhu diṭṭhigatam etaṃ.
an7.54:2.6: Assutavā bhikkhu puthujjano diṭṭhiṃ na ppajānāti, diṭṭhisamudayaṃ na ppajānāti, diṭṭhinirodhaṃ na ppajānāti, diṭṭhinirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ na ppajānāti.
an7.54:2.7: Tassa sā diṭṭhi pavaḍḍhati. So na parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, na parimuccati dukkhasmā ti vadāmi.
an7.54:3.1: Sutavā ca kho bhikkhu ariyasāvako diṭṭhiṃ pajānāti, diṭṭhisamudayaṃ pajānāti, diṭṭhinirodhaṃ pajānāti, diṭṭhinirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānāti.
an7.54:3.2: Tassa sā diṭṭhi nirujjhati. So parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, parimuccati dukkhasmā ti vadāmi.
an7.54:3.3: Evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ "hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti pi na vyākaroti;
an7.54:3.4: "na hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti pi na vyākaroti;
an7.54:3.5: "hoti ca na ca hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti pi na vyākaroti;
an7.54:3.6: "neva hoti na na hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti pi na vyākaroti.
an7.54:3.7: Evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ evaṃ avyākaraṇadhammo hoti avyākatavatthūsu.
an7.54:3.8: Evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ na cchambhati na kampati na vedhati na santāsaṃ āpajjati avyākatavatthūsu.
an7.54:4.1: "Hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti kho bhikkhu taṇhāgatam etaṃ
an7.54:4.7: "na hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti kho bhikkhu vippaṭisāro eso;
an7.54:4.8: "hoti ca na ca hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti kho bhikkhu vippaṭisāro eso;
an7.54:4.9: "neva hoti na na hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti kho bhikkhu vippaṭisāro eso.
an7.54:4.10: Assutavā bhikkhu puthujjano vippaṭisāraṃ na ppajānāti, vippaṭisārasamudayaṃ na ppajānāti, vippaṭisāranirodhaṃ na ppajānāti, vippaṭisāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ na ppajānāti.
an7.54:4.11: Tassa so vippaṭisāro pavaḍḍhati. So na parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, na parimuccati dukkhasmā ti vadāmi.
an7.54:5.1: Sutavā ca kho bhikkhu ariyasāvako vippaṭisāraṃ pajānāti, vippaṭisārasamudayaṃ pajānāti, vippaṭisāranirodhaṃ pajānāti, vippaṭisāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānāti.
an7.54:5.2: Tassa so vippaṭisāro nirujjhati. So parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, parimuccati dukkhasmā ti vadāmi.
an7.54:5.3: Evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ "hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti pi na vyākaroti; "na hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti pi na vyākaroti; "hoti ca na ca hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti pi na vyākaroti;
an7.54:5.4: "neva hoti na na hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā" ti pi na vyākaroti.
an7.54:5.5: Evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ evaṃ avyākaraṇadhammo hoti avyākatavatthūsu.
an7.54:5.6: Evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ na cchambhati na kampati na vedhati na santāsaṃ āpajjati avyākatavatthūsu.
an7.54:5.7: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayaṃ paccayo, yena sutavato ariyasāvakassa vicikicchā n' uppajjati avyākatavatthūsū'
